foliar_symptoms.initial_lesion_appearance: Vibrant green turgid blade, uniform venation without chlorosis
foliar_symptoms.lesion_morphology: Smooth entire leaf margin, fully expanded photosynthetic lamina
foliar_symptoms.chlorosis_pattern: No chlorosis present; optimal chlorophyll content
foliar_symptoms.adaxial_surface_texture: Glossy, intact waxy cuticle with active stomatal conductance
foliar_symptoms.abaxial_surface_texture: Clean, healthy stomatal pores free from fungal hyphae

reproductive_structure_symptoms.fruit_lesion_characteristics: Firm, uniform epidermis, normal pigment synthesis

transmission_and_survival.primary_inoculum_source: Infected plant debris, solanaceous weeds, contaminated certified seed lots
transmission_and_survival.overwintering_structures: Chlamydospores, sclerotia, and melanized mycelium surviving in top 15cm soil

cultural_sanitation: Implement strict 3 to 4-year crop rotation with non-host botanical families (e.g. Poaceae, Fabaceae).
Eradicate volunteer host plants and solanaceous weeds within 50 meters of field perimeter.
Utilize drip or subsurface trickle irrigation to maintain dry leaf canopy and reduce wetness duration.
Ensure row spacing of at least 75cm to maximize inter-row aerodynamic ventilation and solar penetration.
Sterilize pruning equipment, trellising stakes, and harvester baskets with 10% sodium hypochlorite solution.
Post-harvest deep moldboard plowing (>25cm depth) to bury crop residues and accelerate microbial breakdown.

biological_controls.application_method: High-volume foliar spray at early dawn
biological_controls.mode_of_action: Competitive exclusion, lipopeptide disruption of cell membranes, systemic acquired resistance (SAR) induction

biological_controls.application_method: Root drench and furrow application at transplanting
biological_controls.mode_of_action: Mycoparasitism, chitinase enzyme secretion, rhizosphere colonization
Ecdysone receptor antagonism and fungal conidia germination inhibition

chemical_fungicide_programs.resistance_management_risk: High - Strict alternation with multi-site contact fungicide required
chemical_fungicide_programs.ecotoxicity_rating: Harmful to aquatic organisms; low mammalian toxicity

chemical_fungicide_programs.resistance_management_risk: Low - No documented resistance due to multi-site enzyme inactivation
chemical_fungicide_programs.ecotoxicity_rating: Moderate; wear nitrile gloves and respirator mask during tank mixing
Toxic to aquatic life; observe 10m untreated riparian buffer zone
Avoid soil copper accumulation; use minimum effective dosage

tier_1_preventative_or_trace.protocol_action: Deploy preventative bio-fungicide (Bacillus subtilis) and spray protective Mancozeb buffer. Increase scouting to 48-hour cadence.

tier_2_moderate_establishment.protocol_action: Initiate curative systemic fungicide application (Difenoconazole or Azoxystrobin) tank-mixed with multi-site contact protectant. Halt all overhead watering.

tier_3_critical_epidemic.protocol_action: Emergency sanitation: strip severely necrotic foliage and burn off-site. Apply high-potency systemic combination spray. Assess early salvage harvest of mature yield.

plant_nutrition_and_physiological_defens.nitrogen_recommendation: Avoid excess nitrate-nitrogen which creates lush, vulnerable cellular walls; switch to balanced nitrate-to-ammonium ratios.
plant_nutrition_and_physiological_defens.potassium_recommendation: Elevate soluble potassium (K2O) by 25% to fortify epidermal cell thickness and accelerate wound suberization.
plant_nutrition_and_physiological_defens.silicon_soil_amendment: Apply potassium silicate (K2SiO3) at 5 L/ha to deposit opal phytoliths in leaf cuticle, creating mechanical barrier against fungal haustoria.
plant_nutrition_and_physiological_defens.foliar_micronutrients: Foliar application of zinc (0.05%) and boron (0.02%) to support lignin synthesis and membrane integrity.

northern_india_gangetic_plains.recommended_surveillance: Monitor morning fog dissipation time; if fog persists past 11:00 AM for 3 consecutive days, spray preventive protectant.

southern_india_deccan_plateau.recommended_surveillance: Inspect abaxial leaf surface on shaded bottom canopy within 24 hours of tropical depression rainfall.

sub_saharan_africa.historical_frequency_years: High severity in bi-modal rainfall belts
sub_saharan_africa.recommended_surveillance: Combine resistant seeds with intercropping of maize or cassava to reduce pathogen spore trajectories.

north_america_midwest.recommended_surveillance: Utilize weather-driven spore traps and digital automated spore counters synced to CropVision cloud.
